overall: The AG found the Town Administrator's Audit Committee, which the Select Board effectively directed into existence, is a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law, and ordered it to comply and keep accurate minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the Select Board created an Audit Committee that is a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law; the Board argued it did not create the committee.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Committee is a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: The complaint did not allege that the Committee had actually violated the law, since it had not yet met when the complaint was filed.

remedy: The Committee must comply with the Open Meeting Law immediately and in the future.
the Committee must create accurate minutes for any meetings it has held, including its December 19 meeting.
remedy_passage: The Committee must comply with the Open Meeting Law immediately and in the future.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
